meta.title: Quantum Sphere — Turnkey construction works | Slovakia

hero.title: Complete construction solutions under one roof
hero.subtitle: We cover the full range of trades, from solar power plants to roofing. One company, five trades, one accountable partner.

about.title: About Quantum Sphere
about.body: We are a construction company based in Slovakia. We specialise in comprehensive delivery across five trades. We work for both business and private clients, and thanks to our own teams in every trade we can carry out most projects without subcontractors.

featuredProjects.title: Selected projects
featuredProjects.subtitle: A sample of projects from recent years

solar.name: Solar power plants
solar.tagline: Turnkey design and installation of PV systems

meta.title: Turnkey solar power plants | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Design, supply and installation of photovoltaic systems. Rooftop and ground-mount installations for businesses, municipalities and homes.

hero.title: Photovoltaic systems for businesses and homes
hero.subtitle: From design and project documentation through mounting panels, inverters and batteries to connection to the distribution grid.

solar.description: We deliver photovoltaic power plants for building roofs, ground-mount installations and agri-PV. We work with proven components and manage the whole process with our own team — from the site survey to operational monitoring.

deliverables.title: What we provide
items: Site survey, system design and optimisation
Supply of PV panels, inverters and mounting structures
Monitoring setup and handover to the client

steps.title: Free site survey
steps.body: We assess the roof structure, orientation and shading. We measure consumption and propose the optimal capacity.

steps.title: Quote and contract
steps.body: We present a transparent calculation including subsidies and financing. Once approved, we sign a works contract.

steps.title: Project documentation
steps.body: We prepare the implementation project and arrange all the necessary approvals from the distribution company.

steps.title: Installation and connection
steps.body: Installation usually takes 2–5 days depending on size. Our team handles the installation, wiring and inspection.

steps.title: Handover and service
steps.body: After grid connection and monitoring setup we hand over the work with documentation. We provide a warranty and post-warranty service.

items.q: How long until a solar investment pays back?
items.a: At current electricity prices and with appropriate sizing, payback in Slovakia is most often 6–9 years. We prepare a specific calculation after the site survey.

For family homes, batteries pay off if you generate more than you consume in summer and want to use the surplus in the evening. For businesses with daytime consumption, a PV system without batteries is often more efficient.
Yes. We can guide you through applying for the currently available subsidies. We prepare the documents and can handle communication with the authorities.

electrical.name: Electrical installations

meta.title: Electrical installations for businesses and sites | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Complete high- and low-voltage electrical installations for new builds, renovations and industrial buildings.

hero.title: Electrical installations to standard
hero.subtitle: We deliver high- and low-voltage wiring, distribution boards and intelligent controls for commercial and residential projects.

electrical.description: We cover the entire electrical part of a construction project — from laying cables during the shell stage through fitting distribution boards to inspections and handover. We work with a certified inspection technician and all installations comply with the applicable standards.

deliverables.title: What we provide
items: Low-voltage systems (data, intruder alarm, fire alarm, CCTV)

steps.title: Consultation and survey
steps.body: We go through the construction drawings with you, identify needs and propose the optimal layout.

steps.title: Quote
steps.body: We prepare a detailed itemised budget with a clear material specification.

steps.title: First-fix installation
steps.body: Laying cables, boxes and conduits before plastering. Coordination with the other trades.

steps.title: Final installation
steps.body: Fitting sockets, switches, light fittings, distribution boards and end devices.

steps.title: Inspection and handover
steps.body: Initial professional inspection and test, issuing the inspection report and handing over the work.

items.q: Do you carry out inspections without doing the installation?
items.a: Yes, we provide initial and periodic professional inspections and tests for buildings we did not construct.

items.q: What is the difference between high and low voltage?
items.a: High voltage is the usual 230/400 V wiring for appliances and lighting. Low voltage covers data, telephone, camera, security and fire systems with voltages up to 50 V.

drywall.name: Drywall

meta.title: Drywall works | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Drywall partitions, suspended ceilings, acoustic and fire-rated systems for offices, flats and commercial spaces.

hero.title: Drywall for offices, flats and industry
hero.subtitle: Partitions, ceilings, lining walls and special structures — with attention to acoustics, fire resistance and the quality of the details.

drywall.description: We build drywall structures of all kinds — from simple partitions to multi-layer acoustic and fire-rated systems. We work with Knauf and Rigips systems according to the manufacturer's system rules.

steps.title: Measuring
steps.body: Precise measuring of the space and defining the technical parameters (acoustics, fire).

steps.title: Framework
steps.body: Installing the steel substructure according to the system rules.

steps.title: Boarding
steps.body: Installing the plasterboard, including insulation and service cavities.

steps.title: Jointing and sanding
steps.body: Filling the joints and screw heads, sanding smooth ready for painting.

items.q: What is the fire resistance of drywall partitions?
items.a: Depending on the specific build-up, from EI 15 to EI 90. We design the specific build-up to the requirements of the project.

masonry.name: Masonry

meta.title: Masonry works | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Structural and finishing masonry for new builds and renovations. Bricklaying, plastering, concreting, tiling and paving.

hero.title: Masonry for new builds and renovations
hero.subtitle: We cover the full range of the masonry trade, from foundations to final plaster and tiling.

masonry.description: We carry out masonry work to a quality that matches modern building demands. We work with reputable suppliers of building materials and all work is done by our own stable team.

deliverables.title: What we provide
items: Bricklaying of external and internal walls

steps.title: Survey and costing
steps.body: We assess the scope, propose the approach and prepare a quote.

steps.title: Site preparation
steps.body: Securing materials and protecting adjacent surfaces.

steps.title: Execution
steps.body: Work to the agreed schedule with ongoing quality control.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Cleaning the site, handing over the work and invoicing.

items.q: Do you also do smaller renovations?
items.a: Yes. We carry out renovations of bathroom cores, bathrooms and smaller masonry alterations.

roofing.name: Roof installation

meta.title: Roof installation | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Complete roof deliveries — pitched roofs with clay or metal tiles, flat roofs with membrane waterproofing, sheet-metal work.

hero.title: Roofs with attention to detail
hero.subtitle: Pitched roofs, flat roofs, re-covering and sheet-metal work. We work with Bramac, Tondach, Lindab and Sarnafil systems.

roofing.description: We build roofs for new buildings and renovations. On every roof we focus on the correct build-up, ventilation and quality sheet-metal details, which determine the lifespan of the work.

deliverables.title: What we provide
items: Pitched roofs with clay or concrete tiles

steps.title: Roof survey
steps.body: We assess the condition of the structure and covering and propose the optimal solution.

steps.title: Design and quote
steps.body: A detailed budget with the specific roof build-up.

steps.title: Stripping the old covering
steps.body: For renovations, safe removal and disposal of the old covering.

steps.title: Laying the new build-up
steps.body: Breathable membrane, counter-battens, battens, covering and sheet-metal details.

steps.title: Warranty
steps.body: A 5-year warranty on the work; on materials according to the manufacturer.

items.q: What is the lifespan of clay tiles?
items.a: With quality installation and maintenance, 60–100 years. Sheet-metal elements have a shorter lifespan (20–40 years), so we account for them separately.

items.q: When is a flat roof more suitable?
items.a: Flat roofs suit office and industrial buildings where the roof is used, for example for photovoltaics. For a family home it depends on the architectural concept.

meta.title: About us | Quantum Sphere
meta.description: Quantum Sphere is a construction company based in Slovakia. Five trades, one accountable partner.

about.title: About Quantum Sphere
about.body:
We are a construction company based in Slovakia covering five key trades under one roof. Thanks to our own teams in every trade we can carry out most construction projects without subcontractors — which means faster communication, better coordination of the trades and one accountable contact for the whole project.

We work for both business and private clients. Our goal is to be a long-term partner the client calls back for the next job.

We operate across Slovakia and carry out selected larger projects in neighbouring countries too.
